title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: Jerusalem, Government House
author: (round-up; investigation by E. L. Sukenik)
location_note: Road in the grounds of Government House, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: Two rosette-decorated ossuaries found in road construction belonged to one kokh of a tomb-cave extending under the road.

features.subtype: tomb-cave with kokh containing two rosette ossuaries
features.quote: a part of a tomb-cave which extended under the road
